Loss report: gitlab -> argo
[external] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/0 trigger.push: EventSource webhook secret (Secret pipemaster-github-webhook with key token must exist and match the GitHub webhook; the repository owner and name are placeholders; set them in the EventSource)
[external] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/1 trigger.tag: EventSource webhook secret (Secret pipemaster-github-webhook with key token must exist and match the GitHub webhook; the repository owner and name are placeholders; set them in the EventSource)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build/step/script step.shell: container command sh with a bash-if-present wrapper (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; the container runs bash -e when the image has bash, else sh -e, so bash-only syntax fails under sh)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/release ext.passthrough: inline child jobs (the child pipeline ci/release.yml runs inline as jobs release-created, release-publish; the job release-created fails when the workflow rules of the child pipeline do not create it, as GitLab fails the trigger job, and every job that needs the call waits for it; a variable that a run sets by hand reads as unset in the child conditions, as GitLab does not forward it without forward:pipeline_variables, but its value reaches the scripts of the child jobs, because they run in the same pipeline; a return to GitLab restores the call and the child file only with the round-trip metadata)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/release-created/step/fail step.if: guard in the script that reads context values from env (containerSet has no when, so every step condition runs as a shell guard that reads context values from env; a condition with no guard form disables the script and the container still starts; a containerSet starts every container at once and each waits for its dependencies, and a container that exits non-zero stops its dependents)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/release-created/step/fail step.shell: container command sh with a bash-if-present wrapper (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; the container runs bash -e when the image has bash, else sh -e, so bash-only syntax fails under sh)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/release-created/step/pass step.shell: container command sh with a bash-if-present wrapper (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; the container runs bash -e when the image has bash, else sh -e, so bash-only syntax fails under sh)
